第一章 南下治水(1)

“真是！这究竟是怎么回事？”

“是啊，襄王怎么会自请去安州监督治水？放着大好朝堂就这么走了，说不通啊！”

早朝散去，臣子们鱼贯而出，看似各走各的，却都议论纷纷，一时之间宣政殿外竟有些闹哄哄的。

“我不是说这个……”

“不然是哪个？”

“我是说那治水之方……真是奇了妙了，没想到襄王如此有才，竟可以想出开辟分洪管道、沿途多立闸门之法，一是减弱水势，二可灌溉航运，三可改良土壤，提高农作物产量。重点是，这套方案只需拿出一年的修堤费用就够，却可维持数百年，这可是我东旭王朝之福啊！虽说解决不了根本问题，这嵘河的泥沙最终会导致再次改道，但那也是数百年之后的事了。”

“方法是妙，可治水不是一日之功，襄王此刻选择远离朝堂，这……这……不是等于自断手脚了吗？好不容易才败了平王……”

“咳。大人慎言。”

“是……”说话的人小心地看了四周一眼，“都说左丞高湛被迫辞官告老还乡，大人还如此谨小慎微……”

“只要平王还在的一天，高家随时可能卷土重来，何况高湛是自己辞官，可不是被削去官职，平王虽远在东北，却依然还是个王爷。”

“照大人所言，东宫之位至今虚悬，好不容易请走了平王，襄王这会却自请到安州……又是什么道理？”

“或许为了邀功？或许为了避嫌？”

“啧，就算这治水之方当真奇也妙也，可要立马见到成效可不容易，要邀这功，旷日费时，恐是得不偿失啊。”

“嗯……那就是为了避嫌了。”

“避什么嫌？”问话的人一脸懵然。

那人看了这人一眼，“你可知道平王一派是怎么被一锅端了的？”

“不是平王之母舒贵妃和国师赵全联手图谋皇位吗？所以左丞为了自清主动辞官，平王为此事愤愤不平找了襄王妃麻烦，因此被逐去东北……”

“还不懂？”

“不懂。”

“赵全是谁告的？”

“是如今的襄王妃……所以要避嫌？为什么？”

“这个我也不知道。”

嗄？说来说去还是说不清？

“襄王妃当初告御状是关起门来自个儿跟陛下说的，谁知她对陛下究竟说了什么？我们只看到结果，或许里头有不可告人之秘密，才让襄王非得自请去安州远离朝堂不可……”这人越说嗓音越低，到最后干脆不说了，朝那人摆摆手，“走了，今儿我还有约呢。”

提起国师赵全被处死一案，总是让人遍体生寒，究竟国师是因何事被定罪妖言惑主、扰乱朝纲呢？知情者隐晦不言，不知情者难免浮想联翩，说到底，这国师一案终究是个谜，让人怎么摸也摸不清。

摸不清，索性别摸了，免得哪一天自己怎么死的都不知道……

说话的人疾步离去，问话的人也摸摸鼻子赶忙走开，这样的场景今日在宣政殿门外可以说是一再上演。

六月的天，庭园里是满满的荷花香。

相比早朝时宣政殿外的扰攘不休，荷花亭里的两人倒显得意态悠闲。

但，也仅仅只是显得而已，与那些不知其中缘由的朝中大臣们相比，对一切瞭若指掌的这两人，眼中多了一些不安与浮躁，甚至是焦虑，是怎样也掩饰不了的。

“听冷宫传出来的消息，舒贵妃总嚷嚷着襄王妃是妖女，大家都说她疯了，父亲怎么看？”

长者轻哼了一声，看了女儿一眼，故意道：“一个洛州陵城小小县令之女，能成什么大气候？不过就是刚好皇帝也想借机拔了高氏一族，一时运气好点罢了。”

女子闻言却摇摇头，就事论事道：“女儿不认为那只是运气而已，这个襄王妃聪慧机敏，可说是步步为营，机关算尽。”

长者又咳了几声，端起石几上的茶喝了一口，“再如何机关算尽，她天生凤命的命格永远是一个致命伤，别人不知道，我们却是明明白白的，皇帝如今忌惮她，以后这忌惮只会多不会少，这对襄王而言非常不利。”

“再怎么不利，放眼朝堂，如今除了他，还有谁有资格及能力入主东宫？”

“你会这么想，皇帝也会这么想，全天下的人都会这么想，你说，襄王如何能不自请去安州避避呢？”

“可再怎么避，也是一时而已，太子之位不能永远虚悬，如今大局已定，我们也该做打算了，父亲。”

长者挑了挑眉，“你确定大局已定？”

“女儿不想再等了，女儿已经等得够久了。”

“傻孩子，襄王妃可是天生凤命的奇贵命格，在襄王尚未入主东宫之前，秦氏是不会轻易冒险失去她的……”就算要弃，也得等到坐稳太子之位或是皇位的那一天。

“女儿愿意为侧妃。”

“你愿意永远屈居于她之后？”

“……是。”

“你信这话吗？我不信。”

“父亲……”

“我不信，秦氏一族和襄王也不会信，襄王妃更是不可能信，所以，你觉得你可以轻易嫁给襄王？”

“那父亲以为如何？”

“自是徐徐图之，戒之慎之，你可别忘了，那是妖女啊，舒贵妃并没有疯，这事你知我知……”

所谓空穴不来风，无风不起浪，妖女之所以被称为妖女，自然也不能等闲视之……

总之，小心驶得万年船。

乐正宸才刚从御书房出来，便在不远处看见了母妃身边的掌事宫女如兰，想必先前在朝中谈及治水一事已传进母妃耳里，特让人来请他过去耳提面命一番。

果然，那名宫女一见到他便速速朝他走来——?

“参见襄王殿下，敏贵妃有请。”

乐正宸看了她一眼，往日或许可以借口不理，可前往安州治水一事已定，走一趟也算是告别，想着，他也就不打算推辞。

与此同时，乐华宫里，敏贵妃早已等人等得十分不耐，连午睡也没能好好眯上一会，心里千思百想的都是今日朝中那事。

右丞中书令秦士廉，也就是她的亲哥哥，今日下朝之后特地来宫里找她，为的就是令百官吵得不可开交的治水一事。

说起来这也不稀奇，朝堂之上本就是吵吵闹闹的，但治水事大，不只劳民伤财，这么多年花了一堆银两也没见什么成效，她家那个傻宸儿竟然偏要往那刀子口送，叫她如何不担心？

“母妃。”

乐正宸的请安让伫立在窗边的敏贵妃回过身来，见到儿子，她忙不迭走上前紧紧拉住他的手，“怎么回事？为什么突然自请去安州治水呢？你好不容易才从洛州回到京城，这才第一天上朝你就自请外放，你脑袋瓜究竟在想些什么？”

平王一派和他们纠缠多年，这会他们好不容易才藉着国师赵全一案将高氏一族给驱逐出朝堂，平王放逐东北，平王之母舒贵妃被打入冷宫，平王的外祖父左丞高湛也自请告老还乡，这不正是儿子在朝中大展身手的时候？他却要去南方做那劳什子吃力不讨好的治水工作。

若治水修渠之事容易便罢，偏偏是个劳民伤财又难见成效之工，捞不到功劳不说，若真来个天灾大祸，惹得皇上一怒，便要引火上身。

“母妃莫忘了一事。”

“何事？”

“高氏一族是因为与国师赵全联合图谋皇位才惹下祸端，而始作俑者就是因为国师那句天生凤命的预言。”若非这个预言，平王不会想方设法想把朱延舞娶到手，也不会有接下来那些两王争一女之事了。

Chapter 1 Going south to control floods (1)

"Really! What on earth is going on?"

"Yes, why did Prince Xiang ask himself to go to Anzhou to supervise the flood control? It doesn't make sense that he just left the great court without doing anything!"

After the court dispersed in the morning, the courtiers filed out, seemingly going their own way, but they were all talking about it, and for a while there was some noise outside the Xuanzheng Palace.

"I didn't mean this..."

"Otherwise which one?"

"I mean, the method of controlling water... is really amazing. I didn't expect that King Xiang was so talented that he could come up with a way to open a flood diversion channel and set up multiple gates along the way. First, it weakens the water potential. Second, it can irrigate shipping. Third, it can improve the soil and increase crop yields. Key points.Yes, this plan only costs one year to build the embankment, but it can last for hundreds of years. This is a blessing for our Dongxu Dynasty!Although it cannot solve the fundamental problem, the sediment in the Rong River will eventually change its course, but that will be hundreds of years later."

"The method is wonderful, but water control cannot be accomplished in a day. Prince Xiang has chosen to stay away from the court at this moment. Isn't this... this... the same as cutting off his limbs? It was not easy to defeat Prince Ping..."

"Ahem. Sir, be careful what you say."

"Yes..." The speaker looked around carefully, "It is said that Zuo Cheng Gao Zhan was forced to resign and return to his hometown. You are still so cautious..."

"As long as Prince Ping is still around, the Gao family may make a comeback at any time. What's more, Gao Zhan resigned by himself, not by being stripped of his official position. Although Prince Ping is far away in the northeast, he is still a prince."

"According to what your Excellency said, the position of the East Palace is still vacant. We finally invited King Ping away, but now King Xiang invites himself to Anzhou... What's the reason?"

"Maybe to take credit? Maybe to avoid suspicion?"

"Tsk, even if this method of controlling water is really wonderful, it is not easy to see the results immediately. If you want to ask for this credit, it is time-consuming and may not be worth the gain."

"Well...that's just to avoid suspicion."

"Why avoid suspicion?" The person who asked the question looked confused.

The man glanced at this man and said, "Do you know how Ping Wang's faction was defeated in one pot?"

"Didn't Prince Ping's mother, Concubine Shu, and Imperial Counselor Zhao Quan join forces to seek the throne? So Zuo Cheng resigned on his own initiative in order to clear himself. Prince Ping was angrily and caused trouble for Princess Xiang, so he was expelled to the northeast..."

"Don't understand yet?"

"I don't understand."

"Who sued Zhao Quan?"

"She is the current Princess Xiang...so she wants to avoid suspicion? Why?"

"I don't know that either."

Huh?Still can't explain clearly?

"When Princess Xiang made the imperial complaint, she told His Majesty in person behind closed doors. Who knows what she actually said to His Majesty? We only saw the result. Maybe there was some hidden secret in it, which is why Prince Xiang had to invite himself to Anzhou to stay away from the court..." The man's voice became lower and lower as he spoke, and in the end he simply stopped talking and waved to the man, "Let's go, I still have an appointment today."

Mentioning the case of the execution of the Imperial Preceptor Zhao Quan always makes people feel chilly. Why was the Imperial Preceptor convicted of deceiving the emperor and disrupting the imperial court?Those who are aware of it are cryptic, while those who are not aware of it can't help but speculate. In the final analysis, the case of the Imperial Master is a mystery that no one can figure out.

I couldn't figure it out, so I just touched it, lest I don't know how I died one day...

The person who spoke hurriedly left, and the person who asked the question also rubbed his nose and walked away quickly. This scene can be said to have been played out again and again outside the Xuanzheng Palace today.

On a June day, the garden is filled with the fragrance of lotus flowers.

Compared to the hustle and bustle outside the Xuanzheng Hall in the early morning, the two people in the Lotus Pavilion seemed to be in a relaxed mood.

However, it was just an appearance. Compared with the ministers in the DPRK who didn't know the reason, these two people who knew everything well had a little more uneasiness, impatience, and even anxiety in their eyes, which they couldn't hide no matter how hard they tried.

"I heard the news from the cold palace. Concubine Shu always yells that Princess Xiang is a witch. Everyone says she is crazy. What does father think?"

The elder snorted softly, glanced at his daughter, and said deliberately: "How can a daughter of a small county magistrate in Luozhou Lingcheng become such a big deal? It just so happened that the emperor wanted to take the opportunity to oust the Gao clan, so he had better luck for a while."

When the woman heard this, she shook her head and said matter-of-factly: "My daughter doesn't think it's just luck. This Princess Xiang is smart and astute, and she can be said to be careful at every step, and she knows all the tricks."

The elder coughed a few more times, picked up the tea on the stone table and took a sip, "No matter how hard we try, her fate of being born with a phoenix life will always be a fatal flaw. Others don't know it, but we know it clearly. The emperor is jealous of her now, and he will only be more jealous in the future. This is very detrimental to Prince Xiang."

"No matter how unfavorable it is, looking at the court, besides him, who else has the qualifications and ability to take over the East Palace?"

"You will think so, the emperor will think so, and everyone in the world will think so. Tell me, how could Prince Xiang not invite himself to Anzhou for refuge?"

"But no matter how much we avoid it, it's only for a while. The position of the prince cannot remain vacant forever. Now that the overall situation has been decided, we should make plans, father."

The elder raised his eyebrows, "Are you sure the overall situation has been decided?"

"My daughter doesn't want to wait any longer. My daughter has waited long enough."

"Silly boy, Princess Xiang is born with a very precious destiny. Before Prince Xiang takes over the East Palace, the Qin family will not take the risk of losing her easily..." Even if she wants to give up, she has to wait until the day when she can secure the position of crown prince or the throne.

"My daughter is willing to be a concubine."

"Are you willing to always be second to her?"

"...Yes."

"Do you believe this? I don't."

"Father..."

"I don't believe it, the Qin family and Prince Xiang don't believe it, and it's even impossible for Princess Xiang to believe it. So, do you think you can marry Prince Xiang easily?"

"What does father think?"

"I'm going to figure it out slowly and be cautious. Don't forget that she is a witch. Concubine Shu is not crazy. You know this and I know..."

As the saying goes, there is no wind without fire, and the reason why the witch is called a witch is naturally not to be taken lightly...

In short, be careful when sailing.

Le Zhengchen had just come out of the Imperial Study Room when he saw Ru Lan, the maid in charge of the concubine's side, not far away. It must have been spread to his mother's concubine's ears about the water control mentioned in the court earlier, so she specially asked him to come over and give her advice.

Sure enough, as soon as the palace maid saw him, she walked towards him quickly——?

"See His Royal Highness Prince Xiang, Concubine Min has invited you."

Le Zhengchen glanced at her. In the past, he might have used an excuse to ignore her, but he had already decided to go to Anzhou to control the water, so a trip would be considered a farewell. Thinking about it, he had no intention of refusing.

At the same time, in Lehua Palace, Concubine Min was already waiting impatiently. She couldn't even take a nap for a while, and all she could think about was what happened at court today.

You Cheng Zhongshu ordered Qin Shilian, her brother, to come to the palace to find her after the court today, because of the water control issue that caused all the officials to quarrel.

Speaking of which, it was not unusual. There were always noisy things in the court, but flood control was a major undertaking, which not only cost people and money, but also spent a lot of money over the years with no results. That silly Chen'er of her family actually wanted to send it to the knife's mouth. How could she not be worried?

"Mother concubine."

Le Zhengchen's greeting made Concubine Min, who was standing by the window, turn around. When she saw her son, she hurriedly stepped forward and held his hand tightly, "What's going on? Why did you suddenly ask yourself to go to Anzhou to control the water? You just returned to the capital from Luozhou with great difficulty, and you asked yourself to be released on your first day in court. What are you thinking in your head?"

Prince Ping's faction has been entangled with them for many years. Now they finally managed to expel the Gao family from the court through the case of Zhao Quan, the national counselor. Prince Ping was exiled to the Northeast. Prince Ping's mother Shu Guifei was relegated to the cold palace. Prince Ping's grandfather Zuo Cheng Gao Zhan also resigned and returned to his hometown. Isn't this the time for his son to show off his talents in the court?But he was going to the south to do the thankless flood control work that Lao Shizi did.

If it were easy to control water and build canals, that would be fine, but it was a laborious task that cost people and money and was difficult to achieve results. Not to mention getting no credit, if a natural disaster really happened and made the emperor angry, he would get angry.

"Mother, please don't forget one thing."

"What's the matter?"

"The Gao family got into trouble because they joined forces with the Imperial Preceptor Zhao Quan to seek the throne, and the culprit was because of the Preceptor's prophecy that he would be born with a phoenix." If not for this prophecy, King Ping would not have tried every means to marry Zhu Yanwu, and there would not have been the subsequent fight between the two kings for a daughter.
